services.desc: Scheduled Closings (occasionally updated and posted here): We will be closed for the following dates in 2026: 1/1 (New Year’s Day), 1/28 - 1/31 (snow), 2/7 (maintenance), 6/17 (paving), 11/26 - 11/27 (Thanksgiving), 12/23 - 12/26 (Christmas). We operate on a donation basis for tours, and suggest $10 per adult and $5 per student, with children 5 and under free. Visitors to the Brethren & Mennonite Heritage Center enjoy the friendly and informative volunteer tour guides who help guests navigate the campus and share stories of faith from the Brethren and Mennonites of the Shenandoah Valley.
